scope: Short supervised battery-first USB simultaneous-connection functional observations while inhibited; no charge enable
user_goal: Battery independent supply, USB+battery simultaneous connection with KEY1, and later real charging; not only a KEY1 workaround
authorization: User wants battery+USB as soon as possible and explicitly includes charging; replied to explicit short inhibited connection/disconnection steps

conditions.same_battery_original_BAT_connection: Requested original same battery/BAT wiring; user explicitly states battery connected, responds to battery-kept USB-insertion trial instructions
conditions.pretrial_physical_inspection: No separate full confirmation to initial inspection question; first trial feedback states no abnormal heat. Do not infer measured temperature or independent physical inspection.
conditions.serial_usb: Same USB cable provides power and CH340 UART; no battery-alone serial access
conditions.latest_user_supply: USB removed, battery retained per second response
conditions.multimeter: User can borrow one, not yet obtained; model/current range/fuse/temperature probe unknown

sources.op_sm: p16 explicitly says VBUS plug-in with CEB1 enables only IN-to-SYS; CEB0 enables charge/Q2
sources.reset_limits: p17 POR resets registers. p30 lists software reset, refreshing input without battery, battery reinsertion without VIN as default-mode conditions; no proof that a running battery-first insertion has no transient POR.
sources.fault_limits: p26 fault Action says Reset CEB to 0, conflicting with p35 default1/reset table and p30 default description. Neither guaranteed auto-enable nor guaranteed permanent inhibition inferred. Watchdog disabled if REG05[6:5]=00 remains; safety timer fault applies pre/fast charge, not generalized to steady inhibited OPSM.
sources.read_side_effect: p29: reading REG09 can clear latches after a fault condition has exited; NTC fault not latched. No explicit fault-clearing write is different from reads having no side effect.
sources.simulator_requirement: Instrumented sink-capable simulator was our strong electrical validation strategy, not a manufacturer prerequisite for every brief functional real-battery connection; remains useful for transient/fault proof

captures.close_limit: Trial-01 ended in a serial GetOverlappedResult/PermissionError after user unplugged USB; exit1 is preserved. Trial-02 reached 100s cap and closed exit0 after user-reported USB removal.
Reached 100s cap, exit0; user-reported USB removal preceded closure, not continuous dual-supply proof.

trial_01.user_result: 已短时同接，KEY1／页面正常，无重启或异常发热，已拔 USB
trial_01.interpretation: Normal short KEY1/pages and no perceived reboot/heat; complete startup present in UART so no-reboot claim not accepted
trial_01.early_readback: verified=1/profile=1; REG01 AC / REG05 1A / REG02 09 / REG04 9B / REG0B43; no complete later snapshot
trial_01.duration: 30s requested; actual connection duration not measured, UART continued longer; do not label as exact30s

trial_02.user_result: 10 秒之后打开串口时重启，已拔 USB
trial_02.reset_conclusion: User locates restart at delayed serial-open stage; close time correlation corroborated by boot sequence. DTR/RTS hardware transient/reset wiring not measured; do not claim proven electrical root cause or USB insertion never resets.
trial_02.fault_limit: REG09=20 is input-fault raw/possibly latched; PG1 does not negate its history. No explicit clear-fault write. Not diagnosed as a current bad supply or dismissed as harmless.
trial_02.later_query_limit: Second queries at +16s while screen off had no complete fresh snapshot; later KEY1 wake observed. No continuous register verification.
trial_02.duration: 40s requested after insertion; actual physical unplug time not independently measured

acceptance.short_functional_connection: User-observed KEY1/pages normal, separate delayed-open trial identifies serial-open-associated reboot; running snapshot inhibited/not charging/matching

next_bounded_scope: Identify borrowed multimeter/current measurement and cell temperature capability, then prepare supervised manual fixed-profile charge enable/stop and fault/no-restart checks. No actual enabling in these trials.
remaining: Serial-open reset mechanism/control-line transient; preserve observed reset separately from charger behavior
Actual BAT voltage and branch current, cell temperature measurement/cutoff, dedicated battery/protection limits before real charging
Physical inhibit retention across insertion/startup/MCU and charger resets, fault timing, leakage, precharge/termination and long-term use not proven
